name: ViewRaw
description: Copy and view the raw content/data of any message, channel or guild
summary: View Raw for messages (hover-bar button), servers, channels, users and roles

settings.label: Click method
settings.description: Change the button to view the raw content/data of any message.

choices.label: Left Click to view the raw content.
Right click to view the raw content.

notes: A message's hover bar gets upstream's View Raw button: a left click shows the message's content and data, a right click copies its content (swapped when Click method is Right). With Message context menu on, the message's right-click menu also has View Raw. Servers, channels, threads and group DMs, users (and a profile, from its More button), and roles (in a profile's role list, Server Settings > Roles and PermissionsViewer's list) get View Raw in their right-click menus, showing "Raw <type> Data" with a copy button. The data is what Qord has cached, under Discord's field names, so fields Qord doesn't read are missing; message data has sorted keys and no private author fields, and nothing private (email, phone, MFA) is kept on users.
